name: motif
description: Create portable Motif workbenches for DNA, RNA, protein, annotations, alignments, traces, and results.

interface.longDescription: Create a self-contained Motif workbench for DNA, RNA, and protein records. Codex can find, prepare, analyze, and transform data with its available tools, then organize records, annotations, alignments, traces, cloning designs, and results in a portable HTML workbench.
defaultPrompt: Find the reference sequence for this gene, annotate the regions relevant to my project, and create a Motif workbench.
Compare these DNA and protein constructs, align them, and organize their differences in a Motif workbench.
Review this sequencing trace against its reference and create a Motif workbench with the mismatches and notes.
